note: SC-205 cut 2: one beat a line; gap = silence after it (s). Figures are the 13 Oct production runs' own. 'say' carries Kokoro's phonemes where it misreads.

lines.text: Every day, India's food brands write off stock that sells too slowly.
Too close to expiry for quick commerce, it is destroyed, and its GST credit reversed.
lines.say: Too close to expiry for quick commerce, it is destroyed, and its G S T credit reversed.

lines.text: Smart-Clearance turns that write-off into recovery.
It is software as a service for FMCG brands: each gets its own workspace, where AI agents find the best exit for every pack at risk.
lines.say: It is software as a service for F M C G brands: each gets its own workspace, where AI agents find the best exit for every pack at risk.

lines.text: Ten agents on Gemini, built with Google's Agent Development Kit, walk every batch through nine stops.
The Watcher spots the risk. Vision verifies the label. The Valuer and the Router price every exit.
Then one person says yes.
Outreach, the Lister and the Negotiator sell. Paperwork files the GST papers, and Impact posts the ledger.
lines.say: Outreach, the Lister and the Negotiator sell. Paperwork files the G S T papers, and Impact posts the ledger.

lines.text: In the console, Neha brings a brand on in minutes: its stock export mapped by the Data agent, and its people invited.
Each SKU gets its own quick-commerce gates, and every agent is set to act, ask, or only suggest.
What follows is live, on production. Everyone signs in on their own device, to the real apps.
The API and the agents run on Cloud Run, and every agent reasons with Gemini.
For the demo, Neha switches Munchly to Rehearsal: a journey day passes in an hour, so the real best-before dates still hold.
Priya, in supply chain, gets the Watcher's alert. Munchly's Mango Drink, in Hyderabad: twenty-two days left, twenty-two thousand rupees at stake.
lines.say: [Priya](/pɹˈijə/), in supply chain, gets the Watcher's alert. Munchly's Mango Drink, in Hyderabad: twenty-two days left, twenty-two thousand rupees at stake.

lines.text: Lakshmi Agencies, the distributor, is asked for one photo. Vision matches the carton's label to the stock export.
The Valuer prices every exit, and the Router splits the batch. Priya approves the plan with one tap.
lines.say: The Valuer prices every exit, and the Router splits the batch. [Priya](/pɹˈijə/) approves the plan with one tap.

lines.text: Outreach sends the offer to fifty-eight kiranas in their own language: in this demo, Hindi. A shopkeeper orders on her phone, and the order lands on Priya's screen, live.
lines.say: Outreach sends the offer to fifty-eight kiranas in their own language: in this demo, Hindi. A shopkeeper orders on her phone, and the order lands on [Priya's](/pɹˈijəz/) screen, live.

lines.text: Next on the roadmap: more Indian languages, and WhatsApp, to reach kiranas in every remote region.
Fifty-two shops take thirteen hundred and seventy-two packets, each with its own tax invoice.
The godown's staff buy a hundred and fifty packs, paying by UPI, and Vision checks the receipt against the count.
lines.say: The godown's staff buy a hundred and fifty packs, paying by U P I, and Vision checks the receipt against the count.

lines.text: Feeding India collects the last fifty-eight packs, and the Saturday van delivers every shop's order.
Paperwork drafts every paper. Munchly recovers nearly seventeen thousand rupees, and Lakshmi Agencies ends whole.
But not every batch sells. Munchly's Masala Chips go to Rakesh Traders' thirty-eight kiranas in Nagpur, and just two of them order.
lines.say: But not every batch sells. Munchly's Masala Chips go to [Rakesh](/ɹˈɑkAʃ/) Traders' thirty-eight kiranas in Nagpur, and just two of them order.

lines.text: On Expire Soon, a wholesaler in Raipur bids thirteen rupees. The Negotiator counters at fourteen twenty, and seven hundred and seventy-two packs are sold.
lines.say: On Expire Soon, a wholesaler in [Raipur](/ɹɑˈipʊɹ/) bids thirteen rupees. The Negotiator counters at fourteen twenty, and seven hundred and seventy-two packs are sold.

lines.text: Five hundred and forty packets are still left when the offer window closes.
On expiry day, Rakesh is asked to destroy them through an authorised agency, and to prove it.
lines.say: On expiry day, [Rakesh](/ɹˈɑkAʃ/) is asked to destroy them through an authorised agency, and to prove it.

lines.text: At the landfill, he photographs the destruction. Then the agency's officer, two witnesses and Rakesh sign the certificate on his tablet.
lines.say: At the landfill, he photographs the destruction. Then the agency's officer, two witnesses and [Rakesh](/ɹˈɑkAʃ/) sign the certificate on his tablet.

lines.text: Vision checks the photos. Only on Priya's second yes are the certificate and the credit note issued.
lines.say: Vision checks the photos. Only on [Priya's](/pɹˈijəz/) second yes are the certificate and the credit note issued.

lines.text: Even here, Munchly recovers eleven thousand seven hundred rupees against a twenty-six thousand rupee write-off, and Rakesh ends whole.
lines.say: Even here, Munchly recovers eleven thousand seven hundred rupees against a twenty-six thousand rupee write-off, and [Rakesh](/ɹˈɑkAʃ/) ends whole.

lines.text: Smart-Clearance. Live on Cloud Run, reasoning with Gemini. Ten agents, one yes, and nothing good goes to waste.
